We used to have a society where a single working parent could own a decent home, support a family, and rely on a secure 30-year pension backed by local factories that anchored the community. Today, that human-centric world has been replaced by a predatory machine that demands infinite stock market growth at the expense of human dignity. To feed this corporate greed, prices must rise every single year, meaning workers spend 30 to 40 years paying hyper-inflated costs that quietly erase the value of their long-term savings.
